claims: Skit numbers: 2,459 new downloads in 7 days; $289 revenue (overlay says $4,289); content reached 96,000; $475 ad spend at 1.5x ROAS; 13 support tickets resolved automatically; 3 users requested the same feature; work handed to 'Tom the developer agent'
Claude Design builds the Jarvis dashboard code in about 5 minutes from a reference image
Each stat is sourced from a specific MCP (Stripe, social analytics, Meta ads, Gmail)
how_to_steps: Find a reference image of a Jarvis-style dashboard online and feed it to Claude Design to generate the UI
Add voice with the ElevenLabs API, choosing any voice
Connect Stripe MCP to pull previous-day revenue
Connect a social analytics MCP to pull TikTok/LinkedIn/Instagram metrics
Connect Meta Ads MCP for spend/ROAS; download and transcribe creatives for Claude Vision analysis
Connect Gmail MCP to pull yesterday's emails and have a Claude agent answer them
Have the agent hand feature requests to a developer agent
on_screen_only: Opening overlay: 'POV: Jarvis is building you a $30k MRR app'; subtitle 'How's the app doing?'
Picture-in-picture captions: 'downloads and generated $4,289 in', 'On ads, you spent $475 at a 1.5 Return on ad', 'three users asked for the same feature, a'
Stripe 'S' logo and Gmail 'M' logo shown next to 'MCP to' captions
cta: Follow; comment a video link for him to react to

relevance.why: The daily-metrics agent (Stripe + ads + socials + inbox into one spoken/visual brief) is a concrete, high-leverage pattern for a time-poor solo founder running apps, and it maps onto the GOOSE/morning-brief setup already in place.

implement_score.why: Stripe and Gmail MCPs exist today; a Claude Code scheduled task could produce the brief in a few hours of work. Voice and Jarvis UI are cosmetic. The social-analytics MCP name is unclear and must be identified; the $30k MRR framing is a skit.
